description: §66.1 rule 5 / §66.12: a spread `...a` in a tape value is a run of `a`'s elements, each a value of the target's element type — spreading a `string[]` into an `int[]` is E-TYPE-031.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S435 "type, and 1 both, 2 lift, 3 C, 4 suppress" (one sequence kind, typed elements)
rationale: An annotated initializer is checked against its annotation (§7.5.1, §66.1 rule 5); the spread's elements are `string`, the annotation's element type `int`.
